environment.description: AWS Lambda behind Application Load Balancer with standard HTTPS listener (port 443). ALB target group forwards all requests matching path /api/upload to the Lambda. No WAF attached. ALB listener uses ACM certificate for server-side TLS only. Security group allows 0.0.0.0/0 inbound on 443. S3 bucket has public read enabled via bucket policy for serving uploaded content. No CloudFront distribution in front.
